REDESIGN the Size Charts list page at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.size-charts.tsx` to production-grade quality matching the dashboard design style.

READ the file first. Keep the EXACT same loader and action code. Only redesign the component UI.

## Dashboard Design Reference
The dashboard (app._index.tsx) uses these design patterns for a clean, polished look:
- Custom card styles: `{ background: "#ffffff", border: "1px solid #e3e3e3", borderRadius: "12px", padding: "20px" }`
- Section titles: `{ fontSize: "15px", fontWeight: 650, color: "#202223", margin: 0 }`
- Custom badges: inline-block, `padding: "2px 8px"`, `borderRadius: "10px"`, `fontSize: "11px"`, `fontWeight: 600` with tone-based colors (success: green bg/text, info: blue, neutral: gray)
- Clean list rows: flex between, `padding: "12px 0"`, `borderBottom: "1px solid #f1f1f1"`
- Progress bars: `height: "6px"`, colored fill with transition

## What to Redesign (Component Only)

### 1. Page Header
- Keep `<s-page heading="Size Charts">` with primary action "Create chart"
- Add subtitle showing count: `<s-text tone="neutral">Manage your size charts and assign them to products</s-text>`

### 2. Template Picker — Make it visually richer
When showTemplates is true:
- Wrap in a card-style container like dashboard
- Section title "Choose a starting point" in the sectionTitle style
- Templates in a CSS grid `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr))` with `gap: "10px"`
- Each template card:
  - White background, `border: "1px solid #e3e3e3"`, `borderRadius: "10px"`, `padding: "14px"`
  - Template name in bold (`fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "14px"`)
  - Category + gender + size count in small neutral text
  - "Use Template" button
  - Hover effect: on hover, `borderColor: "#005bd3"` (use onMouseEnter/Leave)
- Blank chart card: dashed border, light gray background
- "Close" button (X) at top-right of the template section

### 3. Filters — Clean inline bar
- Wrap in a card-style container
- Filters inline: category select, status select, count text
- Style selects consistently: `border: "1px solid #c9cccf"`, `borderRadius: "8px"`, `padding: "6px 12px"`, `fontSize: "13px"`, `background: "#fff"`
- Show "X of Y charts" at the right

### 4. Charts List — Clean card rows like dashboard
If no charts → centered empty state with icon, description, CTA
If charts but no filter match → "No charts match" with "Clear filters" button

Each chart row inside a card container:
- Row layout: flex between
- Left side:
  - Chart name as clickable `<s-link>` (bold)
  - Below: badges (status + category) + assignment count + date
  - Use the dashboard badge style (custom colored spans, NOT `<s-badge>`)
- Right side: action buttons inline
  - "Edit" link button
  - "Publish/Unpublish" toggle
  - "Duplicate" button
  - "Delete" critical button
- Each row separated by `borderBottom: "1px solid #f1f1f1"`, last row no border

### 5. Sidebar — Chart Limits
- Plan name badge
- Usage: "X / Y published" with progress bar (same style as dashboard)
- Upgrade button for free plan

### 6. Sidebar — Quick Tips
- Keep as-is with `<s-unordered-list>`

## Style Constants (put at top of component, same as dashboard)
```typescript
const cardStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  background: "#ffffff",
  border: "1px solid #e3e3e3",
  borderRadius: "12px",
  padding: "20px",
};
const sectionTitle: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontSize: "15px",
  fontWeight: 650,
  color: "#202223",
  margin: 0,
};
const badgeStyle = (tone: "success" | "neutral" | "info"): React.CSSProperties => ({
  display: "inline-block",
  padding: "2px 8px",
  borderRadius: "10px",
  fontSize: "11px",
  fontWeight: 600,
  lineHeight: "18px",
  background: tone === "success" ? "#c8f9e8" : tone === "info" ? "#e4e5f7" : "#e4e5e7",
  color: tone === "success" ? "#0d6832" : tone === "info" ? "#3b3f8c" : "#6d7175",
});
```

## Rules
- Keep loader and action EXACTLY as-is
- Keep ActionData type, CATEGORY_LABELS, formatDate as-is
- TypeScript strict, zero `any`
- `useAppBridge()` for toasts
- All existing functionality must work (create, delete, duplicate, toggle, filter)
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` after changes to verify

Here is a summary of every change made and what was left untouched.

## What was changed

File: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.size-charts.tsx`

### Preserved exactly
- `loader` (lines 10–39) — untouched
- `action` (lines 41–177) — untouched
- `ActionData` type, `CATEGORY_LABELS`, `formatDate` — untouched
- All form `<input type="hidden">` fields and fetcher wiring — untouched

### New additions
1. **Style constants block** — `cardStyle`, `sectionTitle`, `badgeStyle()` defined once at module level, identical to the dashboard's style tokens.
2. **`hoveredTemplate` state** — drives the interactive border highlight on template cards.

### Redesigned sections

**Page header** — added `<s-text tone="neutral">` subtitle below the heading, kept the primary-action button.

**Plan limit banner** — replaced `<s-banner>` with a styled `div` using an amber card (`#fff8ec` / `#ffd79d` border) with a right-aligned "Upgrade plan" CTA button, matching dashboard card language.

**Template picker** — now lives inside a `cardStyle` `div`. Header row has the section title on the left and a plain "Close" button on the right. Template cards use a CSS grid (`repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr))`) with `onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave` toggling `borderColor` to `#005bd3`. Template name is bold `14px`, meta is `12px` neutral. The blank card uses a dashed border that also highlights on hover.

**Filter bar** — wrapped in `cardStyle`. Selects use `border: "1px solid #c9cccf"`, `borderRadius: "8px"`, `padding: "6px 12px"`, `fontSize: "13px"`. Count text is right-aligned via `marginLeft: "auto"`.

**Charts list** — wrapped in `cardStyle` with a `sectionTitle` header. Empty state uses a circular icon container (same pattern as dashboard), bold heading, description, and CTA button. Filter-empty state has its own heading and "Clear filters" button. Each chart row uses flex-between layout at `padding: "14px 0"` with `borderBottom: "1px solid #f1f1f1"` (last row omits border). Badges use `badgeStyle()` custom spans instead of `<s-badge>`. Chart name is bold via an inline `<span>` wrapping `<s-link>`. Meta row shows status badge, category badge, assignment count, dot separator, and updated date all inline.

**Sidebar — Chart Limits** — wrapped in a nested `cardStyle` card (padding `16px`). Shows plan badge, bold `X / Y published` text, the 6px progress bar with correct color logic, remaining-slots helper text, and "Upgrade for unlimited" button. Unlimited plans show a plain text message instead.

**Sidebar — Quick Tips** — kept exactly as-is with `<s-unordered-list>`.
